question: At the canonical top-32 operating point, do the 16 documents write into the same slots and overwrite each other, and does that make ORACLE-WRITE's ceiling an allocation artefact?

provenance.verified_import_path: /tmp/amsnap_ovw/cartridges (printed from cwd=/tmp in every job log)

definition.survival_combinatorial: frac of doc d's selected slots that NO later document re-selects
definition.survival_numeric_1e-3: frac of doc d's written (head,slot) value vectors whose relative change from end-of-doc-d to end-of-run is < 1e-3
definition.write_retained_fraction: <V_final - V_before_d, V_after_d - V_before_d> / ||V_after_d - V_before_d||^2 on doc d's slots (1 = the whole increment survives). UNBOUNDED above -- >1 means later writes moved the same slots further in the same direction.
definition.value_cosine_final_vs_after_d: mean cos(V_final, V_after_d) over doc d's written (head,slot) value vectors
definition.subsequent_change_over_own_write: ||V_final - V_after_d|| / ||V_after_d - V_before_d|| -- how big the later documents' net change to d's slots is, relative to the change d itself made
definition.mean_later_writes_per_own_slot: average number of LATER documents that re-select each of doc d's slots

q3_slot_mass.question: share of cartridge attention mass carried by the tf-idf written union vs a mass-ranked per-layer top-32 (same budget), on the UNTOUCHED Phase-1 cartridge

conventions.share_*_norm: layer-average of (mean over query rows of sum_{s in S} a_s), a = cartridge-renormalised routing (DIAG-ROUTING / SCOUT-KEYS convention)
conventions.ratio_of_layer_means: mean_layers(abs mass on S) / mean_layers(abs mass on whole cartridge) (ORACLE-WRITE convention)
conventions.writable: candidates restricted to the 511 trainable slots; slot 0 is the FROZEN attention sink and cannot be written by any AM config

q3_slot_mass.verdict: PARTIALLY REFUTED. The 70.4% figure reproduces exactly (0.7044 MT here vs 0.7044 in SCOUT-KEYS), but the 15.2% figure is a DIFFERENT AGGREGATION of the same quantity: under the identical convention the written union carries 0.2037 (MT) of cartridge mass, not 0.152 (0.152 is the ratio-of-layer-means form, which this run also reproduces at 0.1524). More importantly, 51.1% of the mass-ranked top-32's 70.4% is the single FROZEN sink slot 0, which no AM config can write. Restricted to writable slots the mass-ranked per-layer top-32 carries 0.1954 (MT) -- 0.96x the tf-idf union at a SMALLER budget -- and a budget-matched writable mass-ranked set of 54.4 slots carries 0.2373, only 1.17x. The 4.6x writable-bandwidth gap does not exist.

definition.spearman: rank correlation between two documents' per-layer slot scores (ranking_info.tf, 511 slots), averaged over all 120 document pairs
definition.overlap_with_doc_independent_top32: |top-32 of the ACROSS-DOCUMENT MEAN score  &  doc d's own top-32| / 32 -- 1.0 means the selection carries no document-specific information

solve_side_ref_mass_on_S.definition: value_solve.py:146 -- mass the per-document MT reference queries put on the 32 selected slots under a cartridge-only softmax, averaged over heads

eval_time_mass_on_written_union_phase1_c.definition: softmax over [512 cartridge slots || own-sequence causal prefix]; S = union over the 16 documents of the per-layer selected slots; measured on the UNTOUCHED Phase-1 cartridge
